name: article-writing
title: Article Writing Pipeline
description: End-to-end article writing workflow: research, draft, structural edit (Pocock method), anti-slop pass, and publish.
author: SolFoundy

inputs.name: source_path
inputs.description: Path to source draft, notes, or reference documents

gates.prompt:
Apply structural editing using the Matt Pocock method.

Draft: {{drafter}}
Language: {{lang}}

Your task:
1. Analyze the draft as a DAG — identify which sections depend on which
2. Reorder sections so each builds on what came before
3. Enforce paragraphs ≤240 characters — split longer ones
4. Verify logical flow: no section assumes unintroduced concepts
5. Remove redundant transitions and throat-clearing

Return the structurally edited article.
